quote: Artificial diets might have more fat and energy than live prey fish, suggesting that mandarin fish which accept artificial diets could make good use of fat, while the fish which refuse artificial diets could not.
statement: 人工饲料可能比活饵含有更多的脂肪和能量，这表明接受人工饲料的鳜鱼能更好地利用脂肪，而拒绝人工饲料的鱼则不能。
text_zh: 人工饲料可能比活饵含有更多的脂肪和能量，这表明接受人工饲料的鳜鱼能更好地利用脂肪，而拒绝人工饲料的鱼则不能。
text_en: Artificial feed may contain more fat and energy than live bait, suggesting that mandarin fish accepting artificial feed can utilize fat better, while those rejecting it cannot.
outcome: 脂肪利用效率/摄食行为
counterevidence: 拒绝人工饲料的鱼无法有效利用脂肪

quote: Mandarin fish were and domesticated and fed with artificial diets (Table 5 ) and divided into two groups: fish did not eat artificial diets and fish ate artificial diets.
statement: 鳜鱼经过驯化并投喂人工饲料，根据是否摄食人工饲料分为两组。
text_zh: 鳜鱼经过驯化并投喂人工饲料，根据是否摄食人工饲料分为两组。
text_en: Mandarin fish were acclimated and fed artificial feed, and divided into two groups based on whether they consumed the artificial feed.

quote: The fish did not eat artificial diets during the first domestication process was then fed with live fish prey for three days, starved for two days and fed with artificial diets for one day, and then we selected the fish did not eat artificial diets during the second domestication process and repeated the domestication process for one more time.
statement: 首次驯化中不摄食人工饲料的鱼，先投喂活饵三天，再禁食两天，最后投喂人工饲料一天，并重复该过程以筛选持续拒食者。
text_zh: 首次驯化中不摄食人工饲料的鱼，先投喂活饵三天，再禁食两天，最后投喂人工饲料一天，并重复该过程以筛选持续拒食者。
text_en: For fish that do not eat artificial feed during initial domestication, first feed live bait for three days, then fast for two days, and finally feed artificial feed for one day, repeating this process to screen for persistent non-feeders.
intervention_record: 间歇禁食与活饵过渡驯化

quote: The fish ate artificial diets during the first domestication process was fed with live fish prey for one days and fed with artificial diets for three days, then we selected the fish ate artificial diets during the second domestication process and repeated the domestication process for one more time.
statement: 首次驯化中摄食人工饲料的鱼，先投喂活饵一天，再投喂人工饲料三天，并重复该过程以筛选持续摄食者。
text_zh: 首次驯化中摄食人工饲料的鱼，先投喂活饵一天，再投喂人工饲料三天，并重复该过程以筛选持续摄食者。
text_en: In the first domestication, fish that ate artificial feed were first fed live bait for one day, then fed artificial feed for three days, and this process was repeated to screen for persistent eaters.

quote: maintained in the aquarium (12 tanks, 50 fish per tank) at constant temperature (25 ± 0.5 °C).
statement: 鱼在恒温（25 ± 0.5 °C）的水族箱中饲养，每缸50条。
text_zh: 鱼在恒温（25 ± 0.5 °C）的水族箱中饲养，每缸50条。
text_en: Fish were reared in aquaria at a constant temperature (25 ± 0.5 °C), with 50 fish per tank.

quote: All fish stocking and capturing procedures complied with the animal welfare laws of the Government of China and the ethical rules of the Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee of the Institute of Hydrobiology (Approval ID: Keshuizhuan 08529).
statement: 所有鱼类放流和捕获程序均符合中国政府的动物福利法以及水生生物研究所机构动物护理和使用委员会的伦理规则。
text_zh: 所有鱼类放流和捕获程序均符合中国政府的动物福利法以及水生生物研究所机构动物护理和使用委员会的伦理规则。
text_en: All fish release and capture procedures complied with the animal welfare laws of the Chinese government and the ethical rules of the Institute of Hydrobiology's Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee.
outcome: 操作合规性与伦理审查

quote: studies on optimizing stocking density and size of the stocked individuals and its long-term improvements should be taken into consideration in future
statement: 未来应考虑关于优化放养密度和个体大小及其长期改进的研究。
text_zh: 未来应考虑关于优化放养密度和个体大小及其长期改进的研究。
text_en: Future research should consider optimizing stocking density and individual size, as well as their long-term improvement.
intervention_record: 优化放养密度和个体大小

quote: Subsequently submerged macrophytes, one of the most important food resources for E . sinensis , gradually decreased due to overstocking of E . sinensis in the past several years
statement: 由于过去几年中华绒螯蟹的过度放养，作为其最重要食物资源之一的沉水植物逐渐减少。
text_zh: 由于过去几年中华绒螯蟹的过度放养，作为其最重要食物资源之一的沉水植物逐渐减少。
text_en: Due to the overstocking of Chinese mitten crabs in recent years, submerged plants, one of their most important food resources, have gradually decreased.
outcome: 栖息地质量与食物资源

quote: These results also indicated that more of the smaller C . auratus (120–159 mm) and P . parva (60–79 mm) were consumed with the increased density of mandarin fish.
statement: 这些结果还表明，随着鳜鱼密度的增加，更多较小的鲤（120-159毫米）和麦穗鱼（60-79毫米）被消耗。
text_zh: 这些结果还表明，随着鳜鱼密度的增加，更多较小的鲤（120-159毫米）和麦穗鱼（60-79毫米）被消耗。
text_en: These results also indicate that as the density of mandarin fish increases, more smaller carp (120-159 mm) and pseudorasbora parva (60-79 mm) are consumed.
outcome: 特定体型个体的被捕食量

quote: The inconsistent response to increased predation risk can possibly be ascribed to the different anti-predation ability among forage fish species.
statement: 对增加的捕食风险的不一致反应可能归因于不同饵料鱼种之间不同的反捕食能力。
text_zh: 对增加的捕食风险的不一致反应可能归因于不同饵料鱼种之间不同的反捕食能力。
text_en: Inconsistent responses to increased predation risk may be attributed to differences in anti-predator abilities among different bait fish species.

quote: At an age of about 1–2 months, they were transported to the lake and released as much as possible over the littoral zone from a boat.
statement: 在约1-2月龄时，它们被运送到湖泊，并尽可能从船上在沿岸带释放。
text_zh: 在约1-2月龄时，它们被运送到湖泊，并尽可能从船上在沿岸带释放。
text_en: At about 1-2 months of age, they are transported to lakes and released from boats in the littoral zone as much as possible.

quote: Flow cytometry analysis showed that hesperetin could reduce SCRV-inducing apoptosis of EPC cells after annexin V-FITC/PI double staining and immunofluorence microscopy observation after JC-1 incubation.
statement: 流式细胞术分析显示，橙皮素可以减少SCRV诱导的EPC细胞凋亡。
text_zh: 流式细胞术分析显示，橙皮素可以减少SCRV诱导的EPC细胞凋亡。
text_en: Flow cytometry analysis showed that hesperetin can reduce SCRV-induced apoptosis in EPC cells.

quote: Thus, our present study indicated that hesperetin possessed antiviral ability against SCRV, suggesting its candidate role for potential effective control of fish rhabdovirus spreading.
statement: 本研究结果表明橙皮素具有抗SCRV病毒的能力，暗示其作为潜在有效控制鱼弹状病毒传播候选药物的角色。
text_zh: 本研究结果表明橙皮素具有抗SCRV病毒的能力，暗示其作为潜在有效控制鱼弹状病毒传播候选药物的角色。
text_en: The results of this study indicate that hesperetin has the ability to resist SCRV virus, suggesting its role as a potential candidate drug for effectively controlling the spread of fish rhabdovirus.

quote: Further mechanical research suggested that hesperetin could block the intru­sion of SCRV into cells after infection.
statement: 进一步的机制研究提示，橙皮素可以在感染后阻断SCRV进入细胞。
text_zh: 进一步的机制研究提示，橙皮素可以在感染后阻断SCRV进入细胞。
text_en: Further mechanistic studies suggest that Hesperetin can block SCRV entry into cells after infection.

quote: Hesperetin also led to a decrease in apoptotic cells and protected the cells from SCRV infection.
statement: 橙皮素还导致凋亡细胞减少，并保护细胞免受SCRV感染。
text_zh: 橙皮素还导致凋亡细胞减少，并保护细胞免受SCRV感染。
text_en: Hesperetin also led to a reduction in apoptotic cells and protected cells from SCRV infection.
outcome: 细胞凋亡与抗感染保护

quote:
However, there are currently no specific drugs to treat these
diseases.
statement: 目前尚无治疗这些疾病的特效药物。
text_zh: 目前尚无治疗这些疾病的特效药物。
text_en: There is currently no specific drug to treat these diseases.

quote:
pre-exposure of hesperetin could
significantly reduce the apoptotic nuclei in the blocking
group, compared to the only-SCRV infected group (Figure
4A), which indicated that hesperetin was able to decrease
apoptosis caused by SCRV in EPC cells.
statement: 与仅感染SCRV组相比，橙皮素预暴露显著减少了阻断组中的凋亡核，表明橙皮素能减少SCRV引起的EPC细胞凋亡。
text_zh: 与仅感染SCRV组相比，橙皮素预暴露显著减少了阻断组中的凋亡核，表明橙皮素能减少SCRV引起的EPC细胞凋亡。
text_en: Compared with the group infected with SCRV only, hesperetin pre-exposure significantly reduced apoptotic nuclei in the blocking group, indicating that hesperetin can reduce SCRV-induced EPC cell apoptosis.

population.species: EPC细胞（鳜鱼虹彩病毒相关）

quote:
The results showed that the percentage of apop­
tosis in the SCRV-alone infected group came to 18.84% (in­
cluding early and late apoptotic cells) at 24 h, while the
hesperetin could retard the cell apoptosis induced by SCRV
to some extent, and the cell apoptosis rates were 11.78%
(Figure 4B).
statement: 流式细胞术结果显示，单独感染SCRV组在24小时时的细胞凋亡率为18.84%，而橙皮素处理将细胞凋亡率降至11.78%，在一定程度上延缓了由SCRV诱导的细胞凋亡。
text_zh: 流式细胞术结果显示，单独感染SCRV组在24小时时的细胞凋亡率为18.84%，而橙皮素处理将细胞凋亡率降至11.78%，在一定程度上延缓了由SCRV诱导的细胞凋亡。
text_en: Flow cytometry results showed that the cell apoptosis rate in the group infected with SCRV alone was 18.84% at 24 hours, while hesperetin treatment reduced the cell apoptosis rate to 11.78%, delaying SCRV-induced cell apoptosis to a certain extent.

population.species: EPC细胞（鳜鱼虹彩病毒相关）

quote: In this study, we explored its antiviral function against Siniperca chuatsi rhabdovirus (SCRV), one strain of important fish viral viruses, resulting in multiple transmissions and devastating damage in aquaculture.
statement: 本研究探讨了橙皮素对鳜鱼弹状病毒（SCRV）的抗病毒功能，该病毒是导致水产养殖中多次传播和毁灭性损害的重要鱼类病毒株之一。
text_zh: 本研究探讨了橙皮素对鳜鱼弹状病毒（SCRV）的抗病毒功能，该病毒是导致水产养殖中多次传播和毁灭性损害的重要鱼类病毒株之一。
text_en: This study investigated the antiviral function of hesperetin against Siniperca chuatsi rhabdovirus (SCRV), which is one of the important fish virus strains causing multiple outbreaks and devastating damage in aquaculture.

quote: In addition, qRT-PCR and western blot analysis confirmed that hesperetin could significantly inhibit the expression of SCRV nucleoprotein.
statement: 此外，qRT-PCR和蛋白质印迹分析证实，橙皮素能显著抑制SCRV核蛋白的表达。
text_zh: 此外，qRT-PCR和蛋白质印迹分析证实，橙皮素能显著抑制SCRV核蛋白的表达。
text_en: In addition, qRT-PCR and Western blot analysis confirmed that hesperetin significantly inhibited the expression of SCRV nucleoprotein.

quote: Hesperetin possessed strong antiviral ability to SCRV.
statement: 橙皮素对SCRV具有强大的抗病毒能力。
text_zh: 橙皮素对SCRV具有强大的抗病毒能力。
text_en: Hesperetin has strong antiviral activity against SCRV.

quote: The results showed that, after 24 h of post-infection, the caspase-3, caspase-8, and caspase-9 activity increased 2.5-fold, 2.1-fold, and 2.7-fold in the SCRV-infected group compared to the blank control group, respectively (Figure 5).
statement: 结果显示，感染后24小时，与空白对照组相比，SCRV感染组的caspase-3、caspase-8和caspase-9活性分别增加了2.5倍、2.1倍和2.7倍。
text_zh: 结果显示，感染后24小时，与空白对照组相比，SCRV感染组的caspase-3、caspase-8和caspase-9活性分别增加了2.5倍、2.1倍和2.7倍。
text_en: The results showed that at 24 hours post-infection, compared with the blank control group, caspase-3, caspase-8 and caspase-9 activities in the SCRV infection group increased by 2.5-fold, 2.1-fold and 2.7-fold, respectively.

quote:
Among them, hes­
peretin could significantly decrease the activity of cas­
pase-3 and caspase-9 in the blocking group compared to
the SCRV-only infected group, while there’s no statistical
difference in caspase-8 activity between the two group cells
(Figure 5).
statement: 与仅感染SCRV的组相比，橙皮素在阻断组中显著降低了caspase-3和caspase-9的活性，但两组间caspase-8活性无统计学差异。
text_zh: 与仅感染SCRV的组相比，橙皮素在阻断组中显著降低了caspase-3和caspase-9的活性，但两组间caspase-8活性无统计学差异。
text_en: Compared to the group infected with SCRV only, hesperetin significantly reduced caspase-3 and caspase-9 activity in the blocking group, but there was no statistically significant difference in caspase-8 activity between the two groups.

quote: Hesperetin inhibited expression of SCRV N protein.
statement: 橙皮素抑制了SCRV N蛋白的表达。
text_zh: 橙皮素抑制了SCRV N蛋白的表达。
text_en: Hesperetin inhibited the expression of SCRV N protein.

quote:
The number of early (AV staining) and late (PI staining) apoptotic cells significantly
decreased in the blocking group (SCRV+HST) at 24 h.
statement: 在24小时时，阻断组（SCRV+HST）中早期（AV染色）和晚期（PI染色）凋亡细胞的数量显著减少。
text_zh: 在24小时时，阻断组（SCRV+HST）中早期（AV染色）和晚期（PI染色）凋亡细胞的数量显著减少。
text_en: At 24 hours, the number of early (AV staining) and late (PI staining) apoptotic cells was significantly reduced in the blocking group (SCRV+HST).

quote: In aquatic virology, hesperetin was also found to protect crayfish against white spot syndrome virus (WSSV) infection, the important invertebrate pathogen in aquaculture.22 It can regulate the innate immunity of cray­ fish and delay and reduce mortality after the WSSV chal­ lenge.
statement: 橙皮苷被发现能保护克氏原螯虾免受白斑综合征病毒（WSSV）感染，通过调节其先天免疫来延迟和降低WSSV攻击后的死亡率。
text_zh: 橙皮苷被发现能保护克氏原螯虾免受白斑综合征病毒（WSSV）感染，通过调节其先天免疫来延迟和降低WSSV攻击后的死亡率。
text_en: Hesperidin was found to protect Procambarus clarkii from white spot syndrome virus (WSSV) infection by modulating its innate immunity to delay and reduce mortality after WSSV challenge.

quote: Obviously, current findings on the dual role of hesperetin in both di­ rectly suppressing SCRV replication and modulating the cell mitochondrial apoptosis, offer a promising candidate molecule and improve the management of SCRV infection, ensuring healthier fish populations and greater economic stability.
statement: 当前关于橙皮苷在直接抑制SCRV复制和调节细胞线粒体凋亡方面的双重作用的研究结果，表明它是一种有前景的候选分子，可改善SCRV感染的管理，确保更健康的鱼类种群。
text_zh: 当前关于橙皮苷在直接抑制SCRV复制和调节细胞线粒体凋亡方面的双重作用的研究结果，表明它是一种有前景的候选分子，可改善SCRV感染的管理，确保更健康的鱼类种群。
text_en: Current research results on the dual role of hesperidin in directly inhibiting SCRV replication and regulating cellular mitochondrial apoptosis indicate that it is a promising candidate molecule for improving the management of SCRV infection, ensuring healthier fish populations.
outcome: 病毒感染管理与鱼群健康

quote: Triplicate groups of Chinese perch (29.51 ± 0.24 g) were fed five isonitrogenous and isolipidic diets containing graded levels of carbohydrate (2.4%, 9.7%, 16.5%, 23.9%, and 30.1%) for 8 weeks.
statement: 鳜鱼被分为三组重复，投喂五种等氮等脂但碳水化合物水平梯度（2.4%、9.7%、16.5%、23.9%和30.1%）的日粮，持续8周。
text_zh: 鳜鱼被分为三组重复，投喂五种等氮等脂但碳水化合物水平梯度（2.4%、9.7%、16.5%、23.9%和30.1%）的日粮，持续8周。
text_en: Mandarin fish were divided into three groups with replicates, fed five iso-nitrogenous and iso-lipidic diets with a gradient of carbohydrate levels (2.4%, 9.7%, 16.5%, 23.9% and 30.1%) for 8 weeks.
intervention_record: 不同碳水化合物水平饲料

quote: pretreatment of hesperetin effectively increased red fluorescence signals in SCRV-infected cells. Green and red signals denote JC-1 monomers and JC-1 aggregates, respectively.
statement: 橙皮素预处理有效增加了SCRV感染细胞中的红色荧光信号（代表JC-1聚集体，指示线粒体膜电位MMP）。
text_zh: 橙皮素预处理有效增加了SCRV感染细胞中的红色荧光信号（代表JC-1聚集体，指示线粒体膜电位MMP）。
text_en: Hesperetin pretreatment effectively increased the red fluorescence signal in SCRV-infected cells (representing JC-1 aggregates, indicating mitochondrial membrane potential MMP).

quote: The whole-body lipid was first increased sharply and then decreased slightly with increased dietary carbohydrate, but the activities of gluconeogenesis pathway related enzymes were all increased significantly (Li et al., 2019), which might also induce hyperglycemia.
statement: 在杂交石斑鱼研究中，随着日粮碳水化合物增加，全身脂质先急剧增加后轻微减少，但糖异生途径相关酶活性均显著增加，这可能也会诱发高血糖。
text_zh: 在杂交石斑鱼研究中，随着日粮碳水化合物增加，全身脂质先急剧增加后轻微减少，但糖异生途径相关酶活性均显著增加，这可能也会诱发高血糖。
text_en: In studies on hybrid grouper, as dietary carbohydrates increased, whole-body lipids first increased sharply and then decreased slightly, but the activities of enzymes related to the gluconeogenesis pathway all increased significantly, which may also induce hyperglycemia.

quote: Additionally, appropriate increase in dietary carbohydrate contents can improve the growth performance, feed efficiency, and immune status in fish (Lee et al., 2003; Peragon et al., 1999).
statement: 适当增加日粮碳水化合物含量可以改善鱼类的生长性能、饲料效率和免疫状态。
text_zh: 适当增加日粮碳水化合物含量可以改善鱼类的生长性能、饲料效率和免疫状态。
text_en: Appropriately increasing dietary carbohydrate content can improve the growth performance, feed efficiency, and immune status of fish.
outcome: 生长性能、饲料效率及免疫状态

quote: On the contrary, excessive addition of carbohydrate to diet leads to growth inhibition, hyperglycemia, metabolic disorders, and reduction of antioxidant abilities (Miao et al., 2011; Prisingkorn et al., 2017), which will pose a huge challenge to the survival of fish.
statement: 相反，日粮中过量添加碳水化合物会导致生长抑制、高血糖、代谢紊乱和抗氧化能力降低，从而对鱼类生存构成巨大挑战。
text_zh: 相反，日粮中过量添加碳水化合物会导致生长抑制、高血糖、代谢紊乱和抗氧化能力降低，从而对鱼类生存构成巨大挑战。
text_en: Conversely, excessive addition of carbohydrates to the diet leads to growth inhibition, hyperglycemia, metabolic disorders, and reduced antioxidant capacity, thereby posing a significant challenge to fish survival.
outcome: 生长、血糖调节、代谢健康及抗氧化能力

quote: causing severe hemorrhagic sepsis in freshwater and marine fish and several economic losses.
statement: SCRV会导致淡水和海水鱼发生严重的败血症并造成经济损失。
text_zh: SCRV会导致淡水和海水鱼发生严重的败血症并造成经济损失。
text_en: SCRV causes severe septicemia in freshwater and marine fish and results in economic losses.

quote: Through a combination of morphological observation, virus titer assay, qRT-PCR and western blot analysis, hes­ peretin was found to inhibit CPE occurrence, lower the progeny virus titer and decrease the expression of SCRV N protein.
statement: 通过形态学观察、病毒滴度测定、qRT-PCR和Western blot分析，发现橙皮素能抑制细胞病变效应（CPE），降低子代病毒滴度并减少SCRV N蛋白的表达。
text_zh: 通过形态学观察、病毒滴度测定、qRT-PCR和Western blot分析，发现橙皮素能抑制细胞病变效应（CPE），降低子代病毒滴度并减少SCRV N蛋白的表达。
text_en: Through morphological observation, virus titer determination, qRT-PCR and Western blot analysis, it was found that hesperetin can inhibit cytopathic effect (CPE), reduce progeny virus titers and decrease the expression of SCRV N protein.

quote: time-of-addition assay was conducted, and our study suggested that pretreatment of hesperetin could efficiently block the SCRV attachment or entry and therefore interfere with the replication of progeny viruses in EPC cells.
statement: 时间添加实验表明，橙皮素的预处理能有效阻断SCRV的吸附或进入，从而干扰EPC细胞中子代病毒的复制。
text_zh: 时间添加实验表明，橙皮素的预处理能有效阻断SCRV的吸附或进入，从而干扰EPC细胞中子代病毒的复制。

text_en: The oxidative stress parameters in this study included malondialdehyde (MDA), superoxide dismutase (SOD), catalase (CAT), and glutathione peroxidase (GSH-Px).

quote: Chinese perch (Siniperca chuatsi) obtained from Chinese Perch Research Center (Wuhan, China) were reared in a recirculating water system (21 ± 0.5°C, 9 ± 0.5 mg/L dissolved oxygen) at the Huazhong Agriculture University for 21 days.
statement: 中华鳜鱼在循环水系统中饲养了21天，水温控制在21±0.5°C，溶解氧为9±0.5 mg/L。
text_zh: 中华鳜鱼在循环水系统中饲养了21天，水温控制在21±0.5°C，溶解氧为9±0.5 mg/L。
text_en: Chinese perch were reared in a recirculating aquaculture system for 21 days, with water temperature controlled at 21±0.5°C and dissolved oxygen at 9±0.5 mg/L.

quote: During the rearing period, Chinese perch were trained to feed artificial diets according to our previous study (Liang et al., 2001).
statement: 在饲养期间，根据先前研究对中华鳜鱼进行了人工饲料摄食训练。
text_zh: 在饲养期间，根据先前研究对中华鳜鱼进行了人工饲料摄食训练。
text_en: During the rearing period, Chinese perch were trained to accept artificial feed based on previous studies.

quote: Then, the fish (initial mean body weight 29.51 ± 0.24 g) were randomly divided into 5 groups (triplicate, n = 39/group) and were fed with 5 experiment diets to apparent satiation by hand twice daily (08:00 and 18:00), respectively.
statement: 鱼被随机分为5组，每天两次（08:00和18:00）通过手工投喂实验饲料至表观饱食。

text_en: Fish were randomly divided into 5 groups and fed experimental diets by hand to apparent satiation twice daily (08:00 and 18:00).

quote: Specific growth rate (SGR), daily feed intake (FI), and feed conversion ratio (FCR) showed the carbohydrate levels-dependence.
statement: 特定生长率、日采食量和饲料转化率表现出对碳水化合物水平的依赖性。
text_zh: 特定生长率、日采食量和饲料转化率表现出对碳水化合物水平的依赖性。
text_en: Specific growth rate, daily feed intake, and feed conversion ratio showed a dependence on carbohydrate levels.
intervention_record: 不同碳水化合物水平饲料

quote: In four feeding time periods, with increased dietary carbohydrate levels, SGR first increased and then decreased, DFI decreased, and FCR first decreased and then increased.
statement: 在四个投喂时间段内，随着膳食碳水化合物水平的增加，特定生长率先升后降，日采食量下降，饲料转化率先降后升。
text_zh: 在四个投喂时间段内，随着膳食碳水化合物水平的增加，特定生长率先升后降，日采食量下降，饲料转化率先降后升。
text_en: During the four feeding periods, as dietary carbohydrate levels increased, specific growth rate first increased and then decreased, daily feed intake decreased, and feed conversion ratio first decreased and then increased.
intervention_record: 不同碳水化合物水平饲料

quote: DFI in 30.1%-carbohydrate diet group was significantly decreased, compared to that in 2.4%-carbohydrate diet group.
statement: 与2.4%碳水化合物饮食组相比，30.1%碳水化合物饮食组的日采食量显著降低。
text_zh: 与2.4%碳水化合物饮食组相比，30.1%碳水化合物饮食组的日采食量显著降低。
text_en: Compared to the 2.4% carbohydrate diet group, the daily feed intake in the 30.1% carbohydrate diet group was significantly reduced.

quote: SGR and DFI were also found to be feeding time periods-dependent.
statement: 特定生长率和日采食量也被发现依赖于投喂时间段。
text_zh: 特定生长率和日采食量也被发现依赖于投喂时间段。
text_en: Specific growth rate and daily feed intake were also found to depend on the feeding time period.

quote: Along with moved feeding time periods, SGR in all carbohydrate diet groups were decreased, and DFI in 16.5%, 23.9%, and 30.1% -carbohydrate diet groups were decreased.
statement: 随着投喂时间段的推移，所有碳水化合物饮食组的特定生长率均下降，且16.5%、23.9%和30.1%碳水化合物饮食组的日采食量也下降。
text_zh: 随着投喂时间段的推移，所有碳水化合物饮食组的特定生长率均下降，且16.5%、23.9%和30.1%碳水化合物饮食组的日采食量也下降。
text_en: As the feeding period progressed, the specific growth rate decreased in all carbohydrate diet groups, and the daily feed intake also decreased in the 16.5%, 23.9%, and 30.1% carbohydrate diet groups.

quote:
The VSI of fish fed dietary carbohydrate levels of 16.5% and 23.9% were significantly
 higher than that of fish fed 2.4% carbohydrate.
statement: 喂食16.5%和23.9%碳水化合物水平的鱼的脏体比（VSI）显著高于喂食2.4%碳水化合物的鱼。
text_zh: 喂食16.5%和23.9%碳水化合物水平的鱼的脏体比（VSI）显著高于喂食2.4%碳水化合物的鱼。
text_en: Fish fed diets with 16.5% and 23.9% carbohydrate levels had significantly higher viscerosomatic index (VSI) than fish fed 2.4% carbohydrates.
intervention_record: 中等至高碳水化合物日粮

quote:
DWG, DFI, and VSI were also found to be feeding time-
 dependent.
statement: 日增重（DWG）、日摄食量（DFI）和脏体比（VSI）被发现具有饲喂时间依赖性。
text_zh: 日增重（DWG）、日摄食量（DFI）和脏体比（VSI）被发现具有饲喂时间依赖性。
text_en: Daily weight gain (DWG), daily feed intake (DFI) and viscera somatic index (VSI) were found to be feeding time-dependent.

quote:
Compared to those of fish fed for 4 weeks, DWG and DFI of fish fed on 30.1%-carbohydrate diet
 for 8 weeks were significantly decreased, and VSI of fish fed on 16.5% and 30.1% -carbohydrate diets were
 all significantly increased.
statement: 与饲喂4周的鱼相比，饲喂30.1%碳水化合物日粮8周的鱼的日增重和日摄食量显著降低，且饲喂16.5%和30.1%碳水化合物日粮的鱼的脏体比均显著增加。
text_zh: 与饲喂4周的鱼相比，饲喂30.1%碳水化合物日粮8周的鱼的日增重和日摄食量显著降低，且饲喂16.5%和30.1%碳水化合物日粮的鱼的脏体比均显著增加。
text_en: Compared to fish fed for 4 weeks, fish fed a diet with 30.1% carbohydrate for 8 weeks had significantly lower daily weight gain and daily feed intake, and the viscera-somatic index of fish fed diets with 16.5% and 30.1% carbohydrate both increased significantly.

quote: Differently, high-carbohydrate (23.9% and 30.1%) group showed the decrease in DWG and PER, and the increase in FCR,compared to 2.4%-carbohydrate group.
statement: 不同之处在于，与2.4%碳水化合物组相比，高碳水化合物（23.9%和30.1%）组的日增重（DWG）和蛋白质保留率（PER）降低，饲料转化率（FCR）升高。
text_zh: 不同之处在于，与2.4%碳水化合物组相比，高碳水化合物（23.9%和30.1%）组的日增重（DWG）和蛋白质保留率（PER）降低，饲料转化率（FCR）升高。
text_en: The difference is that, compared with the 2.4% carbohydrate group, the high-carbohydrate (23.9% and 30.1%) groups had lower daily weight gain (DWG) and protein retention rate (PER), and higher feed conversion ratio (FCR).

quote: Liver crude lipid content of fish fed dietary carbohydrate levels from 16.5–30.1%, and muscle crude lipid content of fish fed dietary carbohydrate levels of 9.7% and 16.5%, were all significantly higher than those of fish fed 2.4% carbohydrate.
statement: 饲喂16.5-30.1%碳水化合物水平饲料的鱼的肝脏粗脂肪含量，以及饲喂9.7%和16.5%碳水化合物水平饲料的鱼的肌肉粗脂肪含量，均显著高于饲喂2.4%碳水化合物饲料的鱼。
text_zh: 饲喂16.5-30.1%碳水化合物水平饲料的鱼的肝脏粗脂肪含量，以及饲喂9.7%和16.5%碳水化合物水平饲料的鱼的肌肉粗脂肪含量，均显著高于饲喂2.4%碳水化合物饲料的鱼。
text_en: The liver crude fat content of fish fed diets with 16.5-30.1% carbohydrate levels, and the muscle crude fat content of fish fed diets with 9.7% and 16.5% carbohydrate levels, were both significantly higher than those of fish fed a diet with 2.4% carbohydrate.
intervention_record: 不同碳水化合物水平饲料

quote: 1significant carbohydrate levels-dependence (P < 0.05); 2significant feeding time-dependence (P < 0.05).
statement: 血清生化指标（如葡萄糖、甘油三酯等）受饲料碳水化合物水平和投喂时间的显著影响。

outcome: 代谢健康/血液生化指标

quote: #means that significantly different from fish fed the same diet for 4 and 8 weeks (P < 0.05).

text_en: Within the same feed group, there were significant differences in some serum biochemical indicators at the 4-week and 8-week feeding time points.
outcome: 代谢健康/血液生化指标

quote: After the 8-week feeding trial, glucose content of fish fed dietary carbohydrate levels from 16.5–30.1% were significantly higher than that of fish fed 2.4% carbohydrate.
statement: 在8周饲养试验后，饲喂16.5-30.1%碳水化合物水平的鱼的葡萄糖含量显著高于饲喂2.4%碳水化合物的鱼。
text_zh: 在8周饲养试验后，饲喂16.5-30.1%碳水化合物水平的鱼的葡萄糖含量显著高于饲喂2.4%碳水化合物的鱼。
text_en: After an 8-week feeding trial, fish fed dietary carbohydrate levels of 16.5-30.1% had significantly higher glucose content than fish fed 2.4% carbohydrates.

quote: The levels of TG, LDL, HDL, TP, ALB, and GLB were also found to be feeding time-dependent.
statement: 甘油三酯、低密度脂蛋白、高密度脂蛋白、总蛋白、白蛋白和球蛋白的水平被发现具有摄食时间依赖性。
text_zh: 甘油三酯、低密度脂蛋白、高密度脂蛋白、总蛋白、白蛋白和球蛋白的水平被发现具有摄食时间依赖性。
text_en: The levels of triglycerides, low-density lipoprotein, high-density lipoprotein, total protein, albumin, and globulin were found to be feeding time-dependent.

quote: Along with moved feeding time, the levels of above plasma indices were all decreased.
statement: 随着摄食时间的推移，上述血浆指标的水平均下降。
text_zh: 随着摄食时间的推移，上述血浆指标的水平均下降。
text_en: As feeding time progressed, the levels of the above plasma indicators all decreased.

quote: OD level of fish fed dietary carbohydrate levels of 23.9% and 30.1% were significantly lower than that of fish fed 2.4% carbohydrate, but MDA showed a completely opposite trend from SOD.
statement: 饲喂23.9%和30.1%碳水化合物日粮的鱼，其超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）水平显著低于饲喂2.4%碳水化合物的鱼，而丙二醛（MDA）的变化趋势与SOD完全相反。
text_zh: 饲喂23.9%和30.1%碳水化合物日粮的鱼，其超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）水平显著低于饲喂2.4%碳水化合物的鱼，而丙二醛（MDA）的变化趋势与SOD完全相反。
text_en: Fish fed diets with 23.9% and 30.1% carbohydrates had significantly lower superoxide dismutase (SOD) levels than fish fed a diet with 2.4% carbohydrates, while the trend of malondialdehyde (MDA) changes was completely opposite to that of SOD.

quote: After the 4-week feeding trial, daily weigh gain (DWG) and protein retention ratio (PER) significantly increased with dietary carbohydrate levels from 2.4–16.5% and significantly decreased with dietary carbohydrate levels from 16.5–30.1%, but FCR showed a completely opposite trend.
statement: 在4周饲养试验后，随着膳食碳水化合物水平从2.4%增加到16.5%，日增重（DWG）和蛋白质保留率（PER）显著增加；当水平从16.5%增加到30.1%时，两者显著下降；而饲料系数（FCR）呈现完全相反的趋势。
text_zh: 在4周饲养试验后，随着膳食碳水化合物水平从2.4%增加到16.5%，日增重（DWG）和蛋白质保留率（PER）显著增加；当水平从16.5%增加到30.1%时，两者显著下降；而饲料系数（FCR）呈现完全相反的趋势。
text_en: After a 4-week feeding trial, daily weight gain (DWG) and protein efficiency ratio (PER) increased significantly as dietary carbohydrate levels rose from 2.4% to 16.5%; both decreased significantly when levels increased from 16.5% to 30.1%; while feed conversion ratio (FCR) showed the completely opposite trend.
intervention_record: 不同碳水化合物水平饲料

quote: The lowest DFI was obtained in 30.1%-carbohydrate diet group and the lowest HSI was obtained in 2.4%-carbohydrate diet group.
statement: 30.1%碳水化合物日粮组的日采食量（DFI）最低，2.4%碳水化合物日粮组的肝体比（HSI）最低。
text_zh: 30.1%碳水化合物日粮组的日采食量（DFI）最低，2.4%碳水化合物日粮组的肝体比（HSI）最低。
text_en: The daily feed intake (DFI) was lowest in the 30.1% carbohydrate diet group, and the hepatosomatic index (HSI) was lowest in the 2.4% carbohydrate diet group.
intervention_record: 不同碳水化合物水平饲料
outcome: 摄食行为与肝脏健康指标

quote: The optimal dietary carbohydrate level was determined to be 10.93% for maximum SGR.
statement: 为获得最大特定生长率（SGR），确定的最佳膳食碳水化合物水平为10.93%。
text_zh: 为获得最大特定生长率（SGR），确定的最佳膳食碳水化合物水平为10.93%。
text_en: To obtain the maximum specific growth rate (SGR), the determined optimal dietary carbohydrate level was 10.93%.

quote: The highest DWG was observed in the 9.7%-carbohydrate diet groups.
statement: 在9.7%碳水化合物日粮组中观察到最高的日增重（DWG）。
text_zh: 在9.7%碳水化合物日粮组中观察到最高的日增重（DWG）。
text_en: The highest daily weight gain (DWG) was observed in the 9.7% carbohydrate diet group.

quote: DWG significantly increased with dietary carbohydrate levels from 2.4–9.7% and then significantly decreased at dietary carbohydrate levels from 9.7–30.1%.
statement: 随着膳食碳水化合物水平从2.4%增加到9.7%，日增重（DWG）显著增加；随后在9.7%至30.1%的水平范围内显著下降。
text_zh: 随着膳食碳水化合物水平从2.4%增加到9.7%，日增重（DWG）显著增加；随后在9.7%至30.1%的水平范围内显著下降。
text_en: As dietary carbohydrate levels increased from 2.4% to 9.7%, daily weight gain (DWG) significantly increased; subsequently, it significantly decreased within the range of 9.7% to 30.1%.
intervention_record: 不同碳水化合物水平饲料

quote: Additionally, DFI did not change significantly with dietary carbohydrate levels from 2.4–16.5% and then significantly decreased at dietary carbohydrate levels from 16.5–30.1%.
statement: 此外，当日粮碳水化合物水平在2.4%至16.5%之间变化时，日采食量（DFI）无显著变化；而在16.5%至30.1%之间则显著下降。
text_zh: 此外，当日粮碳水化合物水平在2.4%至16.5%之间变化时，日采食量（DFI）无显著变化；而在16.5%至30.1%之间则显著下降。
text_en: In addition, when dietary carbohydrate levels varied between 2.4% and 16.5%, daily feed intake (DFI) showed no significant change; however, it decreased significantly between 16.5% and 30.1%.
intervention_record: 不同碳水化合物水平饲料

quote: As well known, glucose intolerance of fish may cause the stress responses (Enes et al., 2010; Lin et al., 2018).
statement: 众所周知，鱼类的葡萄糖不耐受可能会引起应激反应。
text_zh: 众所周知，鱼类的葡萄糖不耐受可能会引起应激反应。
text_en: It is well known that glucose intolerance in fish may cause a stress response.

quote: In this study, higher level of MDA and lower levels of SOD and CAT in high-carbohydrate group than those in low-carbohydrate group.
statement: 在本研究中，高碳水化合物组的MDA水平高于低碳水化合物组，而SOD和CAT水平低于低碳水化合物组。
text_zh: 在本研究中，高碳水化合物组的MDA水平高于低碳水化合物组，而SOD和CAT水平低于低碳水化合物组。
text_en: In this study, MDA levels in the high-carbohydrate group were higher than those in the low-carbohydrate group, while SOD and CAT levels were lower than those in the low-carbohydrate group.

quote: However, moderate-carbohydrate group showed a completely opposite trend in the above indicators, which is consistent with previous studies that moderate dietary carbohydrate enhanced the plasma SO
statement: 然而，中等碳水化合物组在上述指标上表现出完全相反的趋势，这与先前的研究一致，即适度的膳食碳水化合物增强了血浆SO（原文截断）。
text_zh: 然而，中等碳水化合物组在上述指标上表现出完全相反的趋势，这与先前的研究一致，即适度的膳食碳水化合物增强了血浆SO（原文截断）。
text_en: However, the moderate carbohydrate group showed a completely opposite trend in the above indicators, which is consistent with previous studies that moderate dietary carbohydrates enhanced plasma SO (original text truncated).

quote: In addition to growth inhibition and reduced feed utilization after the 8-week feeding trial, elevated plasma glucose level was also been observed in high-carbohydrate group (23.9% and 30.1%), compared to low-carbohydrate group (2.4%), which can be considered to be the glucose intolerance.
statement: 除了8周喂养试验后的生长抑制和饲料利用率降低外，与低碳水化合物组（2.4%）相比，高碳水化合物组（23.9%和30.1%）也观察到血浆葡萄糖水平升高，这可以被认为是葡萄糖不耐受。
text_zh: 除了8周喂养试验后的生长抑制和饲料利用率降低外，与低碳水化合物组（2.4%）相比，高碳水化合物组（23.9%和30.1%）也观察到血浆葡萄糖水平升高，这可以被认为是葡萄糖不耐受。
text_en: In addition to growth inhibition and reduced feed utilization after an 8-week feeding trial, elevated plasma glucose levels were also observed in the high-carbohydrate groups (23.9% and 30.1%) compared to the low-carbohydrate group (2.4%), which may be considered glucose intolerance.
outcome: 生长性能、饲料利用及血糖调节能力

quote: Reduced food intake was also considered to be a direct response to high-carbohydrate diets in an attempt to maintain glucose homeostasis.
statement: 采食量减少也被视为对高碳水化合物饮食的直接反应，旨在维持血糖稳态。
text_zh: 采食量减少也被视为对高碳水化合物饮食的直接反应，旨在维持血糖稳态。
text_en: Reduced feed intake is also considered a direct response to high-carbohydrate diets, aimed at maintaining blood glucose homeostasis.

quote: moderate-carbohydrate group showed a completely opposite trend in the above indicators, which is consistent with previous studies that moderate dietary carbohydrate enhanced the plasma SOD level and excessive dietary carbohydrate decreased the levels of SOD and CAT (Ma et al., 2018; Zhou et al., 2013).
statement: 中等碳水化合物饮食增强了血浆SOD水平，而过量碳水化合物降低了SOD和CAT水平。
text_zh: 中等碳水化合物饮食增强了血浆SOD水平，而过量碳水化合物降低了SOD和CAT水平。
text_en: A moderate carbohydrate diet enhanced plasma SOD levels, while excess carbohydrates reduced SOD and CAT levels.

quote: These results suggested that Chinese perch fed high-carbohydrate diets exhibited symptoms of stress and moderate dietary carbohydrate enhanced the antioxidative capacity.
statement: 高碳水化合物饮食导致鳜鱼出现应激症状，而中等碳水化合物饮食增强了其抗氧化能力。
text_zh: 高碳水化合物饮食导致鳜鱼出现应激症状，而中等碳水化合物饮食增强了其抗氧化能力。
text_en: A high-carbohydrate diet caused stress symptoms in mandarin fish, while a moderate-carbohydrate diet enhanced their antioxidant capacity.

quote: In the present study, compared to low-carbohydrate group at 8 weeks, moderate-carbohydrate group presented the significant increase in the plasma levels of TP, ALB, and GLB, suggesting that moderate-carbohydrate diet can significantly enhance the immune status of Chinese perch.
statement: 与低碳水化合物组相比，中等碳水化合物组在8周时血浆总蛋白、白蛋白和球蛋白水平显著增加，表明中等碳水化合物饮食能显著增强鳜鱼的免疫状态。
text_zh: 与低碳水化合物组相比，中等碳水化合物组在8周时血浆总蛋白、白蛋白和球蛋白水平显著增加，表明中等碳水化合物饮食能显著增强鳜鱼的免疫状态。
text_en: Compared to the low-carbohydrate group, the medium-carbohydrate group showed significantly increased plasma total protein, albumin, and globulin levels at 8 weeks, indicating that a medium-carbohydrate diet can significantly enhance the immune status of mandarin fish.

quote: However, fish fed diets containing 23.9–30.1% carbohydrate showed the completely opposite trend,
statement: 然而，饲喂含23.9–30.1%碳水化合物的鱼的趋势完全相反（即生长和饲料利用率较差）。
text_zh: 然而，饲喂含23.9–30.1%碳水化合物的鱼的趋势完全相反（即生长和饲料利用率较差）。
text_en: However, the trend for fish fed diets containing 23.9–30.1% carbohydrates was completely opposite (i.e., poorer growth and feed utilization).

quote: which is consistent with the reports that adding moderate amounts of carbohydrates to the diet improved the growth performance, and that excessive carbohydrate supplementation led to growth inhibition in some fish species (Wang et al., 2016; Zhang et al., 2009; Zhou et al., 2015).
statement: 这与已有报道一致，即适量添加碳水化合物可改善生长性能，而过量补充碳水化合物会导致某些鱼类生长抑制。
text_zh: 这与已有报道一致，即适量添加碳水化合物可改善生长性能，而过量补充碳水化合物会导致某些鱼类生长抑制。
text_en: This is consistent with existing reports that moderate addition of carbohydrates can improve growth performance, while excessive supplementation of carbohydrates leads to growth inhibition in certain fish species.
intervention_record: 不同碳水化合物水平饲料

quote: This result was in line with the previous report that the inclusion of dietary carbohydrate quadratically and linearly elevated the activity of gluconeogenesis related enzymes in hybrid grouper (Li et al., 2019), indicating that the lack of regulatory mechanism to inhibit gluconeogenesis may be partly responsible for the intolerance of Chinese perch to the carbohydrate-rich diet.
statement: 这一结果与先前关于杂交石斑鱼中膳食碳水化合物的添加二次和线性地提高了糖异生相关酶活性的报道一致，表明缺乏抑制糖异生的调节机制可能是中国鳜对富含碳水化合物饮食不耐受的部分原因。
text_zh: 这一结果与先前关于杂交石斑鱼中膳食碳水化合物的添加二次和线性地提高了糖异生相关酶活性的报道一致，表明缺乏抑制糖异生的调节机制可能是中国鳜对富含碳水化合物饮食不耐受的部分原因。
text_en: This result is consistent with previous reports that the addition of dietary carbohydrates in hybrid grouper increased gluconeogenesis-related enzyme activities quadratically and linearly, indicating that a lack of regulatory mechanisms to inhibit gluconeogenesis may be part of the reason for Chinese perch's intolerance to carbohydrate-rich diets.
outcome: 代谢健康（葡萄糖耐受性）

quote: Additionally, compared to 2.4%-carbohydrate group after 4-weeks feeding, 16.5%-carbohydrate group did not significantly increase the mRNA levels of g6pca and pc associated with gluconeogenesis, but significantly increased the mRNA levels of pk and cs related to aerobic oxidation pathway, which may be directly responsible for the elevated DWG.
statement: 此外，与喂食4周后的2.4%碳水化合物组相比，16.5%碳水化合物组并未显著增加与糖异生相关的g6pca和pc的mRNA水平，但显著增加了与有氧氧化途径相关的pk和cs的mRNA水平，这可能直接导致了日增重（DWG）的提高。
text_zh: 此外，与喂食4周后的2.4%碳水化合物组相比，16.5%碳水化合物组并未显著增加与糖异生相关的g6pca和pc的mRNA水平，但显著增加了与有氧氧化途径相关的pk和cs的mRNA水平，这可能直接导致了日增重（DWG）的提高。
text_en: In addition, compared to the 2.4% carbohydrate group after 4 weeks of feeding, the 16.5% carbohydrate group did not significantly increase the mRNA levels of g6pca and pc related to gluconeogenesis, but significantly increased the mRNA levels of pk and cs related to the aerobic oxidation pathway, which may have directly led to an improvement in daily weight gain (DWG).

quote: Lymphocystivirus infections result in low mortality in fish cultures.
statement: 淋巴囊肿病毒感染的死亡率较低。
text_zh: 淋巴囊肿病毒感染的死亡率较低。
text_en: The mortality rate of lymphocystis virus infection is low.

quote: Meanwhile, carbohydrate-rich diet may have a harmful effect on the antioxidant capacity and immunity of fish.
statement: 同时，高碳水化合物饮食可能对鱼类的抗氧化能力和免疫力产生有害影响。
text_zh: 同时，高碳水化合物饮食可能对鱼类的抗氧化能力和免疫力产生有害影响。
text_en: At the same time, a high-carbohydrate diet may have harmful effects on the antioxidant capacity and immunity of fish.
outcome: 抗氧化能力与免疫状态
counterevidence: 对免疫力和抗氧化能力有潜在危害

quote: The expression of above genes was also found to be feeding time-dependent.
statement: 上述基因的表达被发现具有饲喂时间依赖性。
text_zh: 上述基因的表达被发现具有饲喂时间依赖性。
text_en: The expression of the above genes was found to be feeding time-dependent.

quote: Data on the levels of the plasma oxidative-stress parameters in Chinese perch fed with different dietary carbohydrate levels were shown in Table 7.
statement: 表7展示了饲喂不同膳食碳水化合物水平的鳜鱼血浆氧化应激参数水平数据。
text_zh: 表7展示了饲喂不同膳食碳水化合物水平的鳜鱼血浆氧化应激参数水平数据。
text_en: Table 7 shows the plasma oxidative stress parameter levels of mandarin fish fed diets with different dietary carbohydrate levels.
intervention_record: 不同碳水化合物水平饲料

quote: After the 4-week feeding trial, The lowest SOD level and highest MDA level were observed in 30.1%-carbohydrate diet group.
statement: 在4周饲养试验后，30.1%碳水化合物饲料组观察到最低的SOD水平和最高的MDA水平。
text_zh: 在4周饲养试验后，30.1%碳水化合物饲料组观察到最低的SOD水平和最高的MDA水平。
text_en: After a 4-week feeding trial, the lowest SOD levels and the highest MDA levels were observed in the group fed a diet with 30.1% carbohydrates.
counterevidence: 高碳水化合物导致抗氧化酶降低且脂质过氧化产物升高

quote: the lowest CAT level was observed in 30.1%-carbohydrate diet group.
statement: 在30.1%碳水化合物饲料组观察到最低的CAT水平。
text_zh: 在30.1%碳水化合物饲料组观察到最低的CAT水平。
text_en: The lowest CAT levels were observed in the 30.1% carbohydrate feed group.
counterevidence: 高碳水化合物导致抗氧化酶CAT降低

quote: Subsequently, the selected donor fish was wiped with 70% alcohol for body surface disinfection.
statement: 选定的供体鱼用70%酒精擦拭体表进行消毒。
text_zh: 选定的供体鱼用70%酒精擦拭体表进行消毒。
text_en: The selected donor fish were disinfected by wiping their body surface with 70% alcohol.

quote:
The
DWG of fish fed with 23.9%-carbohydrate diet for 4 weeks and 8 weeks was also significantly different.
statement: 喂食23.9%碳水化合物饮食的鱼在4周和8周的日增重存在显著差异。
text_zh: 喂食23.9%碳水化合物饮食的鱼在4周和8周的日增重存在显著差异。
text_en: Fish fed a 23.9% carbohydrate diet showed significant differences in daily weight gain at 4 and 8 weeks.

quote:
Compared to 2.4%-carbohydrate group after 4-weeks feeding, 23.9%-carbohydrate group did not exhibit the
significant decrease in DWG.
statement: 与2.4%碳水化合物组相比，喂养4周后，23.9%碳水化合物组的日增重未表现出显著下降。
text_zh: 与2.4%碳水化合物组相比，喂养4周后，23.9%碳水化合物组的日增重未表现出显著下降。
text_en: Compared to the 2.4% carbohydrate group, the daily weight gain of the 23.9% carbohydrate group did not show a significant decrease after 4 weeks of feeding.

quote:
However, with the advance of experiment, decreased antioxidant capacity and
damaged liver (decreased number of cell nuclei) were observed at week 8, which might directly lead to a
decrease in DFI and a decrease in DWG.
statement: 随着实验进行，在第8周观察到抗氧化能力下降和肝脏损伤（细胞核数量减少），这可能直接导致摄食量（DFI）和日增重（DWG）下降。
text_zh: 随着实验进行，在第8周观察到抗氧化能力下降和肝脏损伤（细胞核数量减少），这可能直接导致摄食量（DFI）和日增重（DWG）下降。
text_en: As the experiment progressed, a decrease in antioxidant capacity and liver damage (reduced number of nuclei) were observed at week 8, which may have directly led to a decrease in feed intake (DFI) and daily weight gain (DWG).

quote:
Above results indicated Chinese perch might tolerate a carbohydrate-rich
diet for a certain period of time.
statement: 上述结果表明鳜鱼可能在一定时期内耐受高碳水化合物饮食。
text_zh: 上述结果表明鳜鱼可能在一定时期内耐受高碳水化合物饮食。
text_en: The above results indicate that mandarin fish may tolerate a high-carbohydrate diet for a certain period.

quote: Fish mortality was monitored daily for 14 days, with cumulative mortality data collated from the three separate experiments.
statement: 鱼类的死亡率在14天内每天进行监测，并汇总了三次独立实验的累积死亡率数据。
text_zh: 鱼类的死亡率在14天内每天进行监测，并汇总了三次独立实验的累积死亡率数据。
text_en: Fish mortality was monitored daily for 14 days, and cumulative mortality data from three independent experiments were summarized.

quote: Fishes were placed in isolation tanks for one week for quarantine and acclimation to laboratory breeding conditions, and they were randomly sampled for PCR testing of the viral MCP gene to confirm negativity for MRV.
statement: 鱼类被放置在隔离水箱中一周以进行检疫和适应实验室养殖条件，并随机采样进行PCR检测以确认MRV阴性。
text_zh: 鱼类被放置在隔离水箱中一周以进行检疫和适应实验室养殖条件，并随机采样进行PCR检测以确认MRV阴性。
text_en: Fish were placed in quarantine tanks for one week for acclimation to laboratory rearing conditions, and randomly sampled for PCR testing to confirm MRV negativity.

quote: Mandarin fish ranavirus (MRV) infection poses a substantial challenge to the mandarin fish culture industry as no effective preventive or therapeutic measures currently exist.
statement: 鳜鱼蛙病毒（MRV）感染对鳜鱼养殖行业构成重大挑战，因为目前不存在有效的预防或治疗措施。
text_zh: 鳜鱼蛙病毒（MRV）感染对鳜鱼养殖行业构成重大挑战，因为目前不存在有效的预防或治疗措施。
text_en: Infection with mandarin fish frog virus (MRV) poses a major challenge to the mandarin fish aquaculture industry, as there are currently no effective preventive or therapeutic measures.

quote: In vivo experiments revealed that MRV infections led to cumulative mortality rates of 86.9% in mandarin fish and 88.9% in largemouth bass ( Micropterus salmoides ).
statement: 体内实验表明，MRV感染导致鳜鱼的累积死亡率为86.9%，大口黑鲈的累积死亡率为88.9%。
text_zh: 体内实验表明，MRV感染导致鳜鱼的累积死亡率为86.9%，大口黑鲈的累积死亡率为88.9%。
text_en: In vivo experiments showed that MRV infection resulted in a cumulative mortality rate of 86.9% for Siniperca chuatsi and 88.9% for Micropterus salmoides.

population.species: 鳜鱼 (Siniperca chuatsi); 大口黑鲈 (Micropterus salmoides)

quote: megalocytivirus-inactivated vaccines for red sea bream iridovirus (RSIV-I), infectious spleen and kidney necrosis virus (ISKNV-I), and RSIV-II (Aquavac IridoV, MSD) have been developed by using the highly permissive cell lines of mandarin fish fry-1 (MFF-1) or grunt fin (GF)
statement: 利用鳜鱼幼鱼-1（MFF-1）或石首鱼鳍（GF）的高容许性细胞系，已开发出针对红海鲷虹彩病毒（RSIV-I）、传染性脾肾坏死病毒（ISKNV-I）和RSIV-II的巨细胞病毒灭活疫苗。
text_zh: 利用鳜鱼幼鱼-1（MFF-1）或石首鱼鳍（GF）的高容许性细胞系，已开发出针对红海鲷虹彩病毒（RSIV-I）、传染性脾肾坏死病毒（ISKNV-I）和RSIV-II的巨细胞病毒灭活疫苗。
text_en: Cytomegalovirus inactivated vaccines against Red Sea bream iridovirus (RSIV-I), infectious spleen and kidney necrosis virus (ISKNV-I), and RSIV-II have been developed using highly permissive cell lines derived from mandarin fish juvenile-1 (MFF-1) or grouper fin (GF).
intervention: Inactivated vaccine from highly permissive cell lines
intervention_record: 高容许性细胞系开发灭活疫苗

quote: However, effective preventive measures against ranavirus infections like LMBV or MRV in largemouth bass and mandarin fish are yet to be established.
statement: 然而，针对大口黑鲈和鳜鱼中类似LMBV或MRV的蛙病毒感染的有效预防措施尚未建立。
text_zh: 然而，针对大口黑鲈和鳜鱼中类似LMBV或MRV的蛙病毒感染的有效预防措施尚未建立。
text_en: However, effective preventive measures against ranavirus infections similar to LMBV or MRV in largemouth bass and mandarin fish have not been established.

quote: Drawing from strategies against megalocytiviruses, an inactivated vaccine might provide a promising solution.
statement: 借鉴针对巨细胞病毒的策略，灭活疫苗可能提供一种有前景的解决方案。
text_zh: 借鉴针对巨细胞病毒的策略，灭活疫苗可能提供一种有前景的解决方案。
text_en: Drawing on strategies against cytomegalovirus, inactivated vaccines may provide a promising solution.

quote: The virulence of the sixth-passage MRV from SCK-f was subsequently assessed in fish.
statement: 第六代SCK-f来源的MRV对鱼的毒力进行了评估。
text_zh: 第六代SCK-f来源的MRV对鱼的毒力进行了评估。
text_en: The virulence of MRV from the sixth generation SCK-f source to fish was evaluated.

quote: Both mandarin fish and largemouth bass exhibited a series of characteristic symptoms following MRV infection, including anorexia, progressively worsening balance disorder, and the accumulation of ascites.
statement: 鳜鱼和鲈鱼在MRV感染后均表现出厌食、平衡障碍逐渐加重和腹水积聚等一系列特征性症状。
text_zh: 鳜鱼和鲈鱼在MRV感染后均表现出厌食、平衡障碍逐渐加重和腹水积聚等一系列特征性症状。
text_en: Both mandarin fish and sea bass exhibited a series of characteristic symptoms after MRV infection, including anorexia, progressively worsening balance disorders, and ascites accumulation.

quote: The mortality rates reached 86.9% and 88.9% within one week.
statement: 一周内的死亡率分别达到86.9%和88.9%。
text_zh: 一周内的死亡率分别达到86.9%和88.9%。
text_en: Mortality rates reached 86.9% and 88.9% within one week, respectively.

quote: In contrast, the control group showed no deaths over a 14-day observation period.
statement: 相比之下，对照组在14天的观察期内没有死亡。
text_zh: 相比之下，对照组在14天的观察期内没有死亡。
text_en: In contrast, there were no deaths in the control group during the 14-day observation period.

quote: The cumulative mortality rates in MRV-infected mandarin fish and largemouth bass; mean ± SD from three independent experiments.
statement: 研究测量了感染MRV的鳜鱼和鲈鱼的累积死亡率。
text_zh: 研究测量了感染MRV的鳜鱼和鲈鱼的累积死亡率。
text_en: The study measured the cumulative mortality of mandarin fish and sea bass infected with MRV.

quote: Along with the growing scale of the cultivation and the decrease in the water quality in the culture environment, the incidence of the disease is becoming more and more severe
statement: 养殖规模的扩大和养殖环境水质的下降导致疾病发生率日益严重。
text_zh: 养殖规模的扩大和养殖环境水质的下降导致疾病发生率日益严重。
text_en: The expansion of farming scale and the decline in water quality of the farming environment have led to increasingly severe disease incidence rates.

quote: In this study, the conserved sequences of ISKNV MCP gene and A. hydrophila hlyA gene were selected to establish a duplex LAMP detection method, and the two pathogens were distinguished by endonuclease digestion.
statement: 本研究选择了ISKNV MCP基因和气单胞菌hlyA基因的保守序列，建立了双重LAMP检测方法，并通过核酸内切酶消化区分这两种病原体。
text_zh: 本研究选择了ISKNV MCP基因和气单胞菌hlyA基因的保守序列，建立了双重LAMP检测方法，并通过核酸内切酶消化区分这两种病原体。
text_en: This study selected the conserved sequences of the ISKNV MCP gene and the Aeromonas hlyA gene, established a dual LAMP detection method, and distinguished these two pathogens through endonuclease digestion.

quote: This method is particularly suitable for rapid on-site diagnosis of pathogens, and positive and negative results can be visually distinguished directly.
statement: 该方法特别适用于病原体的快速现场诊断，且阳性与阴性结果可直接通过肉眼区分。
text_zh: 该方法特别适用于病原体的快速现场诊断，且阳性与阴性结果可直接通过肉眼区分。
text_en: This method is particularly suitable for rapid on-site diagnosis of pathogens, and positive and negative results can be directly distinguished by the naked eye.

quote: The objective of this article is to develop a technique that enables the quick and concurrent identification of A. hydrophila and ISKNV and to provide an effective tool for the prevention of them.
statement: 本文旨在开发一种能够快速同时鉴定气单胞菌和ISKNV的技术，并为预防这些病原体提供有效工具。
text_zh: 本文旨在开发一种能够快速同时鉴定气单胞菌和ISKNV的技术，并为预防这些病原体提供有效工具。
text_en: This paper aims to develop a technology that can rapidly and simultaneously identify Aeromonas and ISKNV, and provide effective tools for preventing these pathogens.

quote: The specificity of the duplex LAMP-HNB was determined using DNA or cDNA of Siniperca chuatsi Rhabdovirus (SCRV), Cyprinid herpesvirus 2 (CyHV-2), Largemouth bass ranavirus (LMBV), White spot syndrome virus (WSSV), Spring Viraemia of Carp Virus (SVCV), A. hydrophila , Edwardsiella tarda , Plesiomonas shigelloides , etc.
statement: 双链LAMP-HNB的特异性通过使用鳜鱼弹状病毒、鲤疱疹病毒2型等多种病原体的DNA或cDNA进行测定。
text_zh: 双链LAMP-HNB的特异性通过使用鳜鱼弹状病毒、鲤疱疹病毒2型等多种病原体的DNA或cDNA进行测定。
text_en: The specificity of double-stranded LAMP-HNB was determined using DNA or cDNA from multiple pathogens, including Siniperca chuatsi rhabdovirus and Cyprinid herpesvirus 2.

population.species: 鳜鱼（隐含于病原体列表及养殖背景）

quote: The observed mortality rates closely matched the average value of 79.3% reported from five independent outbreaks in aquaculture farms [ 7 ].
statement: 观察到的死亡率与养殖农场五次独立爆发中报告的79.3%平均值紧密匹配。
text_zh: 观察到的死亡率与养殖农场五次独立爆发中报告的79.3%平均值紧密匹配。
text_en: The observed mortality closely matched the reported average of 79.3% across five independent outbreaks at farming farms.

quote: A. hydrophila were responsible for the haemorrhagic septicaemia of Megalobrama amblycephala and Carassius auratus .
statement: 嗜水气单胞菌是导致团头鲂和鲫鱼出血性败血症的原因。
text_zh: 嗜水气单胞菌是导致团头鲂和鲫鱼出血性败血症的原因。
text_en: Aeromonas hydrophila is the cause of hemorrhagic septicemia in Megalobrama amblycephala and Carassius auratus.

quote: It is reported that it can also infect Pelteobagrus fulvidraco , Alosa sapidissima , Procambarus clarkii , Cherax quadricarinatus , Eriocheir sinensis , etc., and cause massive death [ 18 , 19 , 20 , 21 , 22 ].
statement: 据报道，该菌也能感染黄颡鱼、美洲西鲱、克氏原螯虾、红螯螯虾、中华绒螯蟹等，并导致大量死亡。
text_zh: 据报道，该菌也能感染黄颡鱼、美洲西鲱、克氏原螯虾、红螯螯虾、中华绒螯蟹等，并导致大量死亡。
text_en: It is reported that this bacterium can also infect yellow catfish, American shad, red swamp crayfish, red claw crayfish, and Chinese mitten crab, causing mass mortality.

population.species: Pelteobagrus fulvidraco, Alosa sapidissima, Procambarus clarkii, Cherax quadricarinatus, Eriocheir sinensis

quote: If 182 bp, 171 bp and 163 bp fragments were found after enzymatic digestion, the pathogen was A. hydrophila . The pathogen is ISKNV if 136 bp, 117 bp and 96 bp fragments are present following enzymatic digestion. Both A. hydrophila and ISKNV coexist when the above 6 sizes of fragments occur.
statement: 通过酶切后出现的特定DNA片段大小（182/171/163 bp对应嗜水气单胞菌，136/117/96 bp对应ISKNV，六者共存对应混合感染）来鉴定病原体。
text_zh: 通过酶切后出现的特定DNA片段大小（182/171/163 bp对应嗜水气单胞菌，136/117/96 bp对应ISKNV，六者共存对应混合感染）来鉴定病原体。
text_en: Pathogens are identified by the specific DNA fragment sizes appearing after enzymatic digestion (182/171/163 bp corresponding to Aeromonas hydrophila, 136/117/96 bp corresponding to ISKNV, and the coexistence of all six corresponding to mixed infection).
intervention_record: 基于片段大小的病原鉴定

quote: The positive nucleic acids of ISKNV and A. hydrophila were mixed in equal amounts and diluted 10-fold to make the nucleic acid content in the reaction system of 100 ng to 100 fg. Using each gradient as a template, the duplex LAMP-HNB established above was performed. The amplified products were analyzed by agarose gel electrophoresis and visually inspected for chromogenic visuals.
statement: 将ISKNV和嗜水气单胞菌的阳性核酸等量混合并梯度稀释至100 ng到100 fg，使用双链LAMP-HNB方法进行检测，并通过琼脂糖凝胶电泳和显色观察分析扩增产物以评估灵敏度。
text_zh: 将ISKNV和嗜水气单胞菌的阳性核酸等量混合并梯度稀释至100 ng到100 fg，使用双链LAMP-HNB方法进行检测，并通过琼脂糖凝胶电泳和显色观察分析扩增产物以评估灵敏度。
text_en: Equal amounts of positive nucleic acids of ISKNV and Aeromonas hydrophila were mixed and serially diluted to 100 ng to 100 fg, detected using the double-stranded LAMP-HNB method, and sensitivity was assessed by analyzing amplification products via agarose gel electrophoresis and colorimetric observation.

quote: A total of 30 pre-stored fish tissue samples from our laboratory were utilized as clinical testing materials. These samples, which were pre-stored in our laboratory, were collected from various ponds across three breeding farms at multiple time points. The duplex LAMP-HNB was employed for aquatic samples, and its performance was compared with conventional P
statement: 利用来自三个养殖场不同池塘、多个时间点收集的30份预存鱼组织样本进行临床测试，并将双链LAMP-HNB的性能与传统PCR进行比较。
text_zh: 利用来自三个养殖场不同池塘、多个时间点收集的30份预存鱼组织样本进行临床测试，并将双链LAMP-HNB的性能与传统PCR进行比较。
text_en: Clinical testing was performed using 30 pre-stored fish tissue samples collected from different ponds at three farms and multiple time points, comparing the performance of double-stranded LAMP-HNB with conventional PCR.

quote: It can lead to a large number of deaths of juvenile mandarin fish, and the cumulative mortality rate is as high as 100%
statement: 该病毒可导致大量鳜鱼幼鱼死亡，累积死亡率高达100%。
text_zh: 该病毒可导致大量鳜鱼幼鱼死亡，累积死亡率高达100%。
text_en: This virus can cause mass mortality of juvenile mandarin fish, with cumulative mortality reaching up to 100%.

quote: Nielsen et al. carried out bacteriological examination of dead fish in five aquaculture fisheries in Zhejiang Province and isolated 95 bacteria strains.
statement: Nielsen等人对浙江省五个水产养殖渔场的死鱼进行了细菌学检查，并分离出95株细菌。
text_zh: Nielsen等人对浙江省五个水产养殖渔场的死鱼进行了细菌学检查，并分离出95株细菌。
text_en: Nielsen et al. conducted bacteriological examinations of dead fish at five aquaculture farms in Zhejiang Province and isolated 95 bacterial strains.

quote: Bacterial sepsis caused by Aeromonas hydrophila ( A. hydrophila ) and infectious spleen and kidney necrosis virus disease (ISKNVD) caused by infectious spleen and kidney necrosis virus (ISKNV) frequently result in significant mortality among Chinese perch ( Siniperca chuatsi ).
statement: 由嗜水气单胞菌引起的细菌性败血症和由传染性脾肾坏死病毒引起的疾病常导致鳜鱼大量死亡。
text_zh: 由嗜水气单胞菌引起的细菌性败血症和由传染性脾肾坏死病毒引起的疾病常导致鳜鱼大量死亡。
text_en: Bacterial septicemia caused by Aeromonas hydrophila and diseases caused by infectious spleen and kidney necrosis virus often lead to mass mortality of mandarin fish.

quote: Co-infection of mandarin fish with A. hydrophila and ISKNV occurs from time to time.
statement: 鳜鱼偶尔会发生嗜水气单胞菌和传染性脾肾坏死病毒的混合感染。
text_zh: 鳜鱼偶尔会发生嗜水气单胞菌和传染性脾肾坏死病毒的混合感染。
text_en: Mandarin fish occasionally experience mixed infections of Aeromonas hydrophila and infectious spleen and kidney necrosis virus.

quote: In this study, a visual detection method for ISKNV and A. hydrophila was developed, using loop-mediated isothermal amplification (LAMP) and pre-addition of hydroxynaphthol blue.
statement: 本研究开发了一种使用环介导等温扩增（LAMP）和预加羟基萘酚蓝的ISKNV和嗜水气单胞菌目视检测方法。
text_zh: 本研究开发了一种使用环介导等温扩增（LAMP）和预加羟基萘酚蓝的ISKNV和嗜水气单胞菌目视检测方法。
text_en: This study developed a visual detection method for ISKNV and Aeromonas hydrophila using loop-mediated isothermal amplification (LAMP) and pre-added hydroxynaphthol blue.

quote: The results showed that this method amplified bright trapezoidal bands in the presence of only A. hydrophila or ISKNV and both, with sky blue for positive amplification and violet for negative amplification.
statement: 结果显示，该方法在仅存在嗜水气单胞菌、仅存在ISKNV或两者同时存在时均能扩增出明亮的梯形条带，阳性扩增呈天蓝色，阴性扩增呈紫色。
text_zh: 结果显示，该方法在仅存在嗜水气单胞菌、仅存在ISKNV或两者同时存在时均能扩增出明亮的梯形条带，阳性扩增呈天蓝色，阴性扩增呈紫色。
text_en: The results showed that this method could amplify bright trapezoidal bands when Aeromonas hydrophila was present alone, ISKNV was present alone, or both were present simultaneously; positive amplification appeared sky blue, and negative amplification appeared purple.

quote: There was no cross-reactivity with other pathogens, and fragments of 182 bp, 171 bp and 163 bp appeared after digestion of the A. hydrophila LAMP product and 136 bp, 117 bp and 96 bp appeared after digestion of the ISKNV LAMP product.
statement: 与其他病原体无交叉反应，且嗜水气单胞菌LAMP产物酶切后出现182 bp、171 bp和163 bp片段，ISKNV LAMP产物酶切后出现136 bp、117 bp和96 bp片段。
text_zh: 与其他病原体无交叉反应，且嗜水气单胞菌LAMP产物酶切后出现182 bp、171 bp和163 bp片段，ISKNV LAMP产物酶切后出现136 bp、117 bp和96 bp片段。
text_en: There was no cross-reactivity with other pathogens, and the Aeromonas hydrophila LAMP products yielded 182 bp, 171 bp, and 163 bp fragments after enzymatic digestion, while the ISKNV LAMP products yielded 136 bp, 117 bp, and 96 bp fragments after enzymatic digestion.

quote: The minimum detection limit of this method was 100 fg for A. hydrophila and 100 fg for ISKNV, and the minimum detection limit for the mixed template was 1 pg.
statement: 该方法对嗜水气单胞菌和ISKNV的最低检测限均为100 fg，对混合模板的最低检测限为1 pg。
text_zh: 该方法对嗜水气单胞菌和ISKNV的最低检测限均为100 fg，对混合模板的最低检测限为1 pg。
text_en: The limit of detection for this method was 100 fg for both Aeromonas hydrophila and ISKNV, and 1 pg for mixed templates.

quote: Overall, this method has high sensitivity and specificity to rapidly detect and distinguish between the two pathogens.
statement: 总体而言，该方法具有高灵敏度和特异性，能够快速检测和区分这两种病原体。
text_zh: 总体而言，该方法具有高灵敏度和特异性，能够快速检测和区分这两种病原体。
text_en: Overall, this method has high sensitivity and specificity, enabling rapid detection and differentiation of these two pathogens.

quote: Overall, co-infection results in more severe clinical symptoms and higher cumulative mortality compared to single-pathogen infection.
statement: 与单一病原体感染相比，混合感染导致更严重的临床症状和更高的累积死亡率。
text_zh: 与单一病原体感染相比，混合感染导致更严重的临床症状和更高的累积死亡率。
text_en: Compared to single pathogen infection, mixed infection leads to more severe clinical symptoms and higher cumulative mortality.
outcome: 疾病严重程度与死亡率

quote: The mortality rate of mandarin fish infected with ISKNV 1–14 days post-secondary infection with A. hydrophila is significantly higher than that of the ISKNV-only group [ 34 ].
statement: 在ISKNV感染后1-14天继发感染嗜水气单胞菌的鳜鱼死亡率显著高于仅感染ISKNV的组别。
text_zh: 在ISKNV感染后1-14天继发感染嗜水气单胞菌的鳜鱼死亡率显著高于仅感染ISKNV的组别。
text_en: The mortality rate of mandarin fish with secondary Aeromonas hydrophila infection 1-14 days after ISKNV infection was significantly higher than that of the group infected only with ISKNV.

quote: Consequently, controlling secondary bacterial infections may serve as an effective strategy to mitigate the overall mortality rate of hemorrhagic diseases in aquaculture practices.
statement: 控制继发性细菌感染可能是降低水产养殖中出血性疾病总体死亡率的有效策略。
text_zh: 控制继发性细菌感染可能是降低水产养殖中出血性疾病总体死亡率的有效策略。
text_en: Controlling secondary bacterial infections may be an effective strategy to reduce the overall mortality of hemorrhagic diseases in aquaculture.

quote: The minimum detection limit of this method was 100 fg for A. hydrophila ( Figure 5 B) and 100 fg for ISKNV ( Figure 6 B), and the visual results were consistent with the results of agarose gel electrophoresis ( Figure 5 A and Figure 6 A).
statement: 该双联LAMP-HNB方法对嗜水气单胞菌和传染性脾肾坏死病毒的最小检测限均为100飞克，且目视结果与琼脂糖凝胶电泳结果一致。
text_zh: 该双联LAMP-HNB方法对嗜水气单胞菌和传染性脾肾坏死病毒的最小检测限均为100飞克，且目视结果与琼脂糖凝胶电泳结果一致。
text_en: The duplex LAMP-HNB method had a minimum detection limit of 100 femtograms for both Aeromonas hydrophila and infectious spleen and kidney necrosis virus, and the visual results were consistent with the agarose gel electrophoresis results.

quote: In this paper, we successfully established the first visual duplex LAMP-HNB method for the detection of hlyA gene of A. hydrophila and MCP gene of infectious spleen and kidney necrosis virus.
statement: 本研究成功建立了用于检测嗜水气单胞菌hlyA基因和传染性脾肾坏死病毒MCP基因的首个可视化双重LAMP-HNB方法。
text_zh: 本研究成功建立了用于检测嗜水气单胞菌hlyA基因和传染性脾肾坏死病毒MCP基因的首个可视化双重LAMP-HNB方法。
text_en: This study successfully established the first visual dual LAMP-HNB method for detecting the hlyA gene of Aeromonas hydrophila and the MCP gene of Infectious Spleen and Kidney Necrosis Virus.

population.species: 鱼类（隐含，因提及鱼组织）

quote: The new duplex LAMP-HNB can detect both A. hydrophila and ISKNV in an isothermal step, followed by enzymatic analysis to distinguish between the two pathogens.
statement: 新的双重LAMP-HNB可以在恒温步骤中同时检测嗜水气单胞菌和ISKNV，随后通过酶分析区分这两种病原体。
text_zh: 新的双重LAMP-HNB可以在恒温步骤中同时检测嗜水气单胞菌和ISKNV，随后通过酶分析区分这两种病原体。
text_en: The new dual LAMP-HNB can simultaneously detect Aeromonas hydrophila and ISKNV in a constant-temperature step, followed by distinguishing the two pathogens through enzymatic analysis.

quote: The LAMP-LFD detection method established by Ding WC, et al. has high sensitivity, which can detect 10 copies of ISKNV, and its sensitivity surpasses that of traditional LAMP and standard PCR by factors of 10 and 1000, respectively [ 52 ].
statement: 丁等人建立的LAMP-LFD检测方法具有高灵敏度，可检测10个拷贝的ISKNV，其灵敏度分别比传统LAMP和标准PCR高10倍和1000倍。
text_zh: 丁等人建立的LAMP-LFD检测方法具有高灵敏度，可检测10个拷贝的ISKNV，其灵敏度分别比传统LAMP和标准PCR高10倍和1000倍。
text_en: The LAMP-LFD detection method established by Ding et al. has high sensitivity, capable of detecting 10 copies of ISKNV, with sensitivity 10 times and 1000 times higher than traditional LAMP and standard PCR, respectively.

quote: In this method, A. hydrophila , ISKNV and the mixed positive templates were used as positive controls, ddH 2 O was used as negative template and the LAMP reaction was performed using various common pathogenic nucleic acids from mandarin fish.
statement: 在该方法中，嗜水气单胞菌、ISKNV和混合阳性模板被用作阳性对照，ddH2O被用作阴性模板，并使用来自鳜鱼的各种常见病原核酸进行LAMP反应。
text_zh: 在该方法中，嗜水气单胞菌、ISKNV和混合阳性模板被用作阳性对照，ddH2O被用作阴性模板，并使用来自鳜鱼的各种常见病原核酸进行LAMP反应。
text_en: In this method, Aeromonas hydrophila, ISKNV, and mixed positive templates were used as positive controls, ddH2O was used as the negative template, and LAMP reactions were performed using various common pathogen nucleic acids from mandarin fish.

quote: The duplex LAMP-HNB method only requires a common heating device and can even be reacted by a water bath, and the pre-added hydroxynapthol blue can show a visible sky blue color after positive amplification, which is of great significance for the early work of cultivation, because although it is not known what kind of pathogen it is, the appearance of sky blue can provide a reference for on-site detection and initial screening.
statement: 双链LAMP-HNB方法仅需普通加热设备，预加的羟基萘酚蓝在阳性扩增后显示天蓝色，可为现场检测和初步筛查提供参考。
text_zh: 双链LAMP-HNB方法仅需普通加热设备，预加的羟基萘酚蓝在阳性扩增后显示天蓝色，可为现场检测和初步筛查提供参考。
text_en: The double-stranded LAMP-HNB method requires only ordinary heating equipment; the pre-added hydroxynaphthol blue shows sky blue after positive amplification, providing a reference for on-site detection and preliminary screening.
outcome: 病原体早期检测与筛查
